columns.name: customer_segment
columns.expression_sql_original: CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('year', c.created_at, CURRENT_DATE) >  = 5 THEN 'Loyal' WHEN DATEDIFF('year', c.created_at, CURRENT_DATE) >  = 1 THEN 'Regular' ELSE 'New' END

columns.name: profit_margin_pct
columns.expression_sql_original: CASE WHEN p.unit_price > 0 THEN (p.unit_price - p.cost_price) / p.unit_price ELSE 0 END

columns.name: stock_status
columns.expression_sql_original: CASE WHEN p.stock_quantity <  = 0 THEN 'Out of Stock' WHEN p.stock_quantity <  = p.reorder_level THEN 'Low Stock' ELSE 'In Stock' END

columns.name: is_root_category
columns.expression_sql_original: CASE WHEN cat.parent_category_id IS NULL THEN true ELSE false END

columns.name: is_top_level
columns.expression_sql_original: CASE WHEN cat.category_level = 1 THEN true ELSE false END
